prompt: Single game hero sprite: A graceful, powerful, mature male axe-warrior with a tall lean elegant build, about 4.5 heads tall with a small head, never chibi, never cute, never a mascot; the art is stylized for beauty, not realistic: a V-shaped torso with broad swept shoulders narrowing to a very small waist, long slim legs, and every shape drawn as a confident sweeping curve or a sharp clean point, with strong contrast between big smooth curves and sharp tips. TWO ARMS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH and TWO LEGS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH. A calm, hard face: a straight dark brow line, a narrow eye slit, a firm mouth line, a strong narrow jaw, black hair gathered in a high topknot tied with a thin vermilion cord. SIGNATURE FEATURE: on his shoulder on the RIGHT side of the image he wears ONE giant sweeping crescent-shaped shoulder guard of ivory-white lacquered plate with a deep indigo underside, curving up and back like a crane's wing, as big as his whole head, its curve echoing the curve of his axe blade; the shoulder on the LEFT side of the image has only a small indigo cap and a bracer, so the figure is deliberately asymmetric. He wears a long fitted deep indigo cuirass of a few big curved plates with one ivory vertical spine band down the centre, a narrow ivory belt with a vermilion silk sash knotted at the hip, a long coat skirt split into three long pointed tails (one in the centre, one on each side), a bracer on EACH forearm (identical on both arms), and slim greaves and tall boots with pointed upturned toes on EACH leg (identical). In the hand on the LEFT side of the image (his own right hand) he holds ONE very large long-hafted crescent-blade axe: a slim black lacquered haft as tall as his chin with two ivory bands and a vermilion silk ribbon tied under the blade, and at the top ONE huge crescent-moon axe blade of pale steel, taller than his torso, whose outer edge is a single big smooth arc with a thin ivory edge line and whose inner arc is cut away as an open curve, leaving a hollow crescent; held by a clearly visible gripping fist; the hand on the RIGHT side of the image is empty, a relaxed fist the same size as the axe hand. Main colour deep saturated indigo, second colour ivory white, ONE bright accent vermilion red (cord, sash, ribbon). NEAR-FRONT VIEW from a high top-down camera: the body faces the viewer and is turned only about 20 degrees toward the RIGHT of the image, the face looking slightly right, the whole chest visible. The left and right halves of the body are almost mirror images. BOTH ARMS are fully visible and drawn at the SAME size, one on each side of the torso, neither arm hidden behind the body; BOTH LEGS are fully visible, the same size and length, neither hidden. Not a flat profile, not a straight front view. Standing UPRIGHT in a calm, strong neutral idle stance: the body vertical, not leaning, both feet planted wide apart, a little wider than the shoulders, side by side on ONE horizontal ground line, both arms hanging down at his sides in a slight A-pose, held clearly AWAY from the body with a wide gap between each arm and the torso, the arms never crossing in front of the chest or the belly; the axe stands upright beside his left hand, the butt of the haft on the ground line, the haft vertical, the crescent blade at the top, the whole axe clear of the legs and fully inside the frame with the top of the blade at least 8% below the top edge. Full body, centered, filling about 65% of the frame height so that the whole axe fits. Hands are simple blocky fist shapes, visible. Armour and clothing are a few big shapes made of smooth sweeping curves and sharp points; no buckles, no pouches, no rope, no bandages, no spikes, no stitches, no patches, no fabric texture. At most three colour families. The axe, the shoulder guard, the coat tails and every part of the body stay inside the frame with margin on every side. Background: one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no ground, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no border. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere on the subject. Stylized 2D vector game-character art for a top-down fantasy tower defense game, designed to read at about 60 pixels tall. Simple design: big clear shapes and a strong silhouette; small details are left out or merged into larger shapes; faces, hands, armour and clothing are suggested with a few lines, never rendered in fine detail. Stylized, exaggerated game-character proportions, not realistic anatomy and never chibi: the parts that express the character's role (the crescent shoulder guard, the shoulders, the axe blade) are enlarged so the silhouette reads at 60 pixels. Colour: flat solid fills only, no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no noise, no realistic rendering. Volume and shadow come from 2-3 hard-edged tones of the same colour (shadow, base, light), plus a few small highlight shapes. Thick clean outlines in a dark shade of the neighbouring colour. High top-down camera tilted about 60 degrees; light comes from the top-left.
